snippet.title: Neon Speedrunning Plane Game [PAPER.VOID Devlog Teaser #1]
snippet.description:
⚠️ This is Pre-Release gameplay footage of PAPER.VOID. Please be aware that everything shown is subject to change at any given point.

After a few of the PAPER.VOID OSTs dropping 8 months ago, I've been hard at work not working on this game. What started as a University Assignment ended up spiralling into the madness that is this passion project of mine which I'm developing in Unity as the debut release for my indie games studio HUSH! Games

Being a solo dev provides its own set of challenges especially when making games isn't the only thing you find yourself doing in life (and running 2 YouTube channels doesn't help either). However, now that everything has calmed down, I decided its finally time to fully lock in and get this game released to the world

Its pretty scary to think about, but I hope you guys are excited for what I've got in store...

This is one of not too many teaser videos I'll be cooking up for this game as the weeks go by. Unlike the Battle Master: Universe Devlogs I think its much better if I shut up and let the gameplay do the talking since this game is best enjoyed with no interruptions and full immersion with the music and visuals

As mentioned in the video, I have been hiding some more PAPER.VOID OSTs that I've yet to release so stay tuned for whenever I decide to drop those. The game is about to get pretty interesting from this point onwards I can assure you that much

For example, I've yet to implement the dialogue and lore I've cooked up for this game... That'll be fun.

🟧 If you like what you see, please feel free to join the HUSH! Games Discord Community for updates
https://discord.gg/nCuBbGwaJa

== CHAPTERS ==
0:00 - Flying through the Darkness...
0:37 - Suddenly there's boss music
1:50 - New Highscore
2:11 - PAUSED.
2:17 - Main Menu + Username system
2:50 - Slowly flying through the Void...
5:44 - Darkness again
5:57 - Yes you can die in this game
6:13 - HUSH! Games Discord

== LINKS ==

🕶️ The Dev Mafia [Discord Server]: https://discord.gg/9TNSu9bGBW
